assumptions.label: Stage -1 duration (sanction to pilot start)
assumptions.source: PRD s25.1 says 8-16 wk; v2-deep/10 procurement says 2-12 months (MPSEDC nomination faster). Median 5, P90 ~9.5

assumptions.label: Software schedule slip multiplier (Phases 0-2)
assumptions.source: PRD s25.1 durations; technical review 50-62 wk for P0-2 vs PRD ~40 wk implies ~1.25x

assumptions.label: Extra CERT-In/STQC delay before 1a exit
assumptions.source: PRD s25.5 exit needs security audit + STQC; 35-premortem: STQC CQW 5-6 months

assumptions.label: Software vendor contracting lag after Stage -1
assumptions.source: PRD s25.2 separate vendor procurement; v2-deep/10: nomination 2-5 months

assumptions.label: IMC true existing e-waste flow
assumptions.source: PRD s2.2/s26.2 reportedly 60-75 t/month (TOI 2024, unverified; PRD s29.3)

assumptions.label: IMC integration succeeds (MoU signed AND custody logging works)
assumptions.source: PRD s5.1/s25.2 joint order + MoU; assumed P(MoU)=0.75 x P(logging works)=0.8

assumptions.label: Max share of IMC flow brought under EcoSure custody
assumptions.source: Assumption: IMC's two vendors hold existing contracts (19-citizen S3); not all flow reaches pilot recycler

assumptions.label: Share of IMC flow already reaching authorized recyclers (baseline)
assumptions.source: Unknown; PRD s29.3 lists IMC vendor contracts as unverified

assumptions.label: PRO + recycler-direct Indore flow (baseline)
assumptions.source: Assumption; 19-citizen S18: one Indore recycler ~450 t/yr (~37 t/mo, not all Indore-origin)

assumptions.label: Share of PRO/recycler-direct flow tracked on EcoSure
assumptions.source: Assumption: only participating recyclers' flows are logged (PRD s5.3)

assumptions.label: Household market potential in covered wards (24 months)
assumptions.source: 19-citizen: 60% hold e-waste (S9) x intention-action gap ~15-25% (S10)

assumptions.label: Household innovation (spontaneous trial) rate
assumptions.source: Calibrated so solo base ~ 19-citizen monthly first-pickup conversion 0.6-2% of aware holders

assumptions.label: Household imitation (word-of-mouth) rate
assumptions.source: Assumption; typical Bass q 0.1-0.4/yr-equivalents scaled; drives visibility

assumptions.label: Weight per household hand-over
assumptions.source: 19-citizen: 4 kg doorstep assumption; 30-budget: 3 kg; unit-econ: 2.5 kg

assumptions.label: Households covered during manual pilot
assumptions.source: PRD s5.6 Indore only; covered-ward count unspecified (gap). ~750k HH citywide (19-citizen S1)

assumptions.label: Households covered after 1a go-live
assumptions.source: Assumption; 20-70% of IMC area

assumptions.label: Drives per month at maturity
assumptions.source: 19-citizen: 6-12 drives/month recommended; PRD s10.2 C9 150 kg threshold

assumptions.label: Residents per drive
assumptions.source: 19-citizen: 35 at Rs75 incentive

assumptions.label: Repeat hand-overs per adopter per month
assumptions.source: 19-citizen: 10-24% repeat within 12 months

assumptions.label: Informal agents enrolled at maturity
assumptions.source: PRD s25.3 >=8 agents by wk4; 35-premortem: >3,000 waste pickers in Indore; few will sign

assumptions.label: Agent enrolment time constant
assumptions.source: Assumption; PRD s11.2 S1 3-day decision, provisional 500 kg/month

assumptions.label: Agents pre-recruited during Stage -1
assumptions.source: PRD s25.2 recycler MoU + agent agreements in Stage -1

assumptions.label: Gross e-waste handled per agent per month
assumptions.source: 19-citizen: ~13 kg/shop/day; unit-econ: 180 kg typical lot

assumptions.label: Street price minus formal recycler price
assumptions.source: unit-econ Economy 2: street Rs32 vs formal Rs28 plus friction; gap >8 = adverse selection

assumptions.label: Agent base monthly churn
assumptions.source: Assumption; unit-econ: multi-homing when money is slow

assumptions.label: Agent reimbursement median > 7 days
assumptions.source: 35-premortem Story 1: 7-day SLA structurally hard; PRD s17 escrow reduces risk

assumptions.label: Share of agent tonnes that were already formal (recyclers' own aggregators)
assumptions.source: PRD s5.3 layers over recyclers' own networks; assumption

assumptions.label: Bulk/institutional/producer take-back tonnes at maturity
assumptions.source: 30-budget: ~60% of tonnage non-household; 19-citizen S16 BMC 75% non-household

assumptions.label: Share of bulk tonnes that are genuinely additional
assumptions.source: Assumption: Rule 8 already obliges bulk consumers to use authorized channels

assumptions.label: Share of household tonnes cannibalised from IMC/baseline
assumptions.source: 35-premortem Story 2; assumption

assumptions.label: Organic growth of baseline formal flows
assumptions.source: Assumption: generation growth + IMC's own paid pickup app (19-citizen S18)

assumptions.label: Fraud leakage share of incentive spend
assumptions.source: 35-premortem Story 4; PRD s18 controls (handover code, caps); CAG PM-KISAN pattern

assumptions.label: Weight inflation in reported tonnes
assumptions.source: PRD s18.2 dual weighing, 5%/8% tolerance

assumptions.label: Scheme incentive per household hand-over
assumptions.source: PRD s17.3 Rs50 per data-bearing device (illustrative); OQ-70 unset; 30-budget Rs75

assumptions.label: Uplift of IMC flow from EcoSure outreach
assumptions.source: Assumption; 19-citizen F2 IMC co-run effect

assumptions.label: Pilot week-8 operational gate first-try pass probability
assumptions.source: PRD s25.3 five conjunct conditions; assumption

assumptions.label: Fixed-cost overrun multiplier
assumptions.source: 30-budget +10% contingency; government IT overrun norms

assumptions.label: 12-month baseline agreed in Stage -1
assumptions.source: PRD s24.1 / s18.3 tripwire; baseline data may not exist by channel

assumptions.label: Citizen incentive median > 4 working days
assumptions.source: PRD s17.2 treasury batch 1-4 days; v2-deep/07 T+4

assumptions.label: Backup recycler signed before phase 1b
assumptions.source: PRD s27.2 at least one backup recycler

assumptions.label: Incentive budget topped up 50% when exhausted
assumptions.source: Assumption; PRD s26.1 incentives ~Rs39 lakh
